scope: Author triage of saved reviewer output and supplied rules; not independent adjudication, audio review or new training labels.

teacher.rationale: No genre or stylistic category of music (e.g., jazz, rock, country) is expressed. 'That last song' refers to a specific instance by ordinal position, not a stylistic class. Genre identity requires explicit mention or clear contextual implication of a music category, which is absent.

records.issue: Teacher label unavailable conflicts with its own rationale of clear genre absence.
records.author_triage: No expressed genre or stylistic category. Particular song identity may be unknown without making genre presence ambiguous.

teacher.rationale: The phrase 'that last song' expresses a particular work reference but provides no non-genre musical property (e.g., mood, tempo, era, rating). 'Last' indicates recency/ordering, which under ontology rules is not classified as music_descriptor—recency alone does not satisfy the non-genre descriptor predicate without explicit attachment to a musical property role.

records.issue: Teacher rationale denies recency/history-relative selection, despite an explicit inclusion in the supplied descriptor definition.
records.supplied_rule: Genre/style identity and a descriptive property are separate task roles. A genre used to select songs does not automatically satisfy the non-genre descriptor predicate. Quality/rating, mood, tempo, era, history-relative selection, topic or use context can support music_descriptor when explicitly attached to music. A named artist, work, platform or playback mode alone cannot. A phrase may express both roles: soft jazz supplies a softness descriptor and jazz genre; best country songs of the nineties supplies quality/era plus genre. A genre word need not be copied into the descriptor label. Classify by the expressed semantic role rather than a native label or rigid dictionary. Terms that may be genre names or descriptive properties without enough context remain unavailable. Do not resolve rating attachment or bare classic using label metadata.
records.author_triage: Last attached to song supplies an ordinal/history-relative musical selection criterion under the current rules; resolving the song identity is unnecessary for role presence.
records.evaluation: Extra output diagnosis only; do not add to the preregistered seven-target calibration denominator.
